name: @activepieces/piece-youtrack
description: JetBrains project management and issue tracking for agile teams.

auth.description:
Connect your YouTrack instance.

**How to get your permanent token:**
1. Log in to your YouTrack instance
2. Click your avatar -> **Profile** -> **Authentication** tab
3. Click **New permanent token**
4. Name it (e.g. "Activepieces") and click **Create**
5. **Copy the token immediately** - it is shown only once
6. Paste it below with your Instance URL

Your **Instance URL** is your browser address, e.g. https://example.youtrack.cloud

baseUrl.description: Your YouTrack URL (e.g. https://example.youtrack.cloud). Do NOT include /api.

apiToken.description: From Profile -> Authentication -> Permanent Tokens. Starts with "perm:".

create_issue.name: create_issue
create_issue.description: Creates a new issue in a YouTrack project.

project.description: Select the YouTrack project to work with.

summary.description: A short, one-line title for the issue.

aiMetadata.description: Create a new issue in a YouTrack project, requiring the target project ID and a summary; optionally set a description and custom fields (priority, assignee, etc.) via a JSON array. Use to file a bug, task, or request. Not idempotent: each call creates a distinct issue.

get_issue.name: get_issue
get_issue.description: Retrieves full details of an issue including all custom field values.

issue.description: Select the issue to work with.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch the full details of a single issue by its ID, including summary, description, and all custom field values. Use to read the current state of a known issue. Read-only and idempotent.

search_issues.name: search_issues
search_issues.description: Searches for issues using YouTrack query syntax. Returns flat rows for spreadsheets.

project.description: Optional: filter by project. Leave empty to search across all projects.

query.description:
YouTrack search query. Examples:
- #unresolved — all unresolved issues
- assignee: me — assigned to you
- Priority: Critical — critical priority
- created: this week — created this week
- summary: login — issues mentioning "login"

limit.description: Maximum issues to return. Default is 100.

aiMetadata.description: Search issues using YouTrack query syntax (e.g. #unresolved, assignee: me, Priority: Critical), optionally scoped to one project. Leave both the project and query empty to list all accessible issues, or supply filters to narrow results. Use to find issues matching criteria before acting on them. Read-only and idempotent.

update_issue.name: update_issue
update_issue.description: Updates an existing issue - summary, description, or custom fields.

issue.description: Select the issue to work with.

summary.description: New summary. Leave empty to keep.

description.description: New description. Leave empty to keep.

aiMetadata.description: Update an existing issue identified by its ID, changing summary, description, and/or custom fields (priority, assignee, etc.); only the fields you provide are modified. Use to edit issue content or set field values. Idempotent: re-applying the same values leaves the issue in the same state.

apply_command.name: apply_command
apply_command.description: Applies a YouTrack command to an issue (e.g. change state, assign, set sprint).

issue.description: Select the issue to work with.

command.description: YouTrack command. Examples: State Fixed | assignee jane.doe | Priority Critical | for me Critical

aiMetadata.description: Apply a free-text YouTrack command to an issue (e.g. "State Fixed", "assignee jane.doe", "Priority Critical") to change its state, assignment, fields, or sprint in one step, optionally with a comment and silent (no-notification) mode. Use for workflow transitions expressed as commands. Mutating; idempotency depends on the command — setting a state or field is idempotent, while appending a comment is not.

add_tag_to_issue.name: add_tag_to_issue
add_tag_to_issue.description: Adds an existing tag to an issue.

issue.description: Select the issue to work with.

tag.description: Select a tag to apply to the issue.

aiMetadata.description: Attach an existing tag to an issue, given both the issue ID and the tag ID; the tag must already exist (use Create Tag first if needed). Idempotent: adding a tag already present leaves the issue unchanged.

remove_tag_from_issue.name: remove_tag_from_issue
remove_tag_from_issue.description: Removes a tag from an issue.

issue.description: Select the issue to work with.

tag.description: Select a tag to apply to the issue.

aiMetadata.description: Detach a tag from an issue, given both the issue ID and the tag ID. Idempotent: removing a tag that is not present has no further effect.

create_tag.name: create_tag
create_tag.description: Creates a new tag in YouTrack.

aiMetadata.description: Create a new tag in YouTrack with a given name, optionally set to auto-remove when an issue is resolved. Use to define a label before applying it to issues. Not idempotent: repeating the call creates another tag with the same name.

list_tags.name: list_tags
list_tags.description: Lists all tags visible to the current user.

query.description: Filter tags by name. Leave empty for all.

aiMetadata.description: List tags visible to the current user, optionally filtered by a name substring; leave the filter empty to return all tags. Use to discover tag IDs before adding or removing tags on an issue. Read-only and idempotent.

upload_attachment.name: upload_attachment
upload_attachment.description: Uploads one or more files as attachments to an existing issue.

issue.description: Select the issue to work with.

files.description: Add files to attach. Each needs a file name and base64-encoded content.

fileName.description: The name the file will have in YouTrack (e.g. "screenshot.png").

fileContent.description: The file content as a Base64 string. Use the Text Helper piece to encode files.

aiMetadata.description: Attach one or more files to an existing issue, given the issue ID plus a file name and Base64-encoded content for each file. Use to add screenshots, logs, or documents to an issue. Not idempotent: each call appends new attachments.

delete_attachment.name: delete_attachment
delete_attachment.description: Deletes an attachment from an issue.

issue.description: Select the issue to work with.

attachmentId.description: The database ID of the attachment (e.g. "134-31"). You can find attachment IDs by using the "Get Issue" action — look for the attachment IDs in the output.

aiMetadata.description: Delete a single attachment from an issue, given the issue ID and the attachment database ID (e.g. "134-31", found via List Attachments or Get Issue). Idempotent: deleting an already-removed attachment has no further effect.

download_attachment.name: download_attachment
download_attachment.description: Downloads an attachment from an issue and returns it as a Base64-encoded string. Use this with the "Upload to Drive" or "Send Email" actions in your flow.

issue.description: Select the issue to work with.

attachmentId.description: The attachment database ID (e.g. "134-31"). Use "List Attachments" to find it.

aiMetadata.description: Download a single attachment from an issue and return its content as Base64 plus metadata, given the issue ID and attachment database ID (e.g. "134-31", found via List Attachments). Use to retrieve file bytes for forwarding to another step. Read-only and idempotent.

get_issue_history.name: get_issue_history
get_issue_history.description: Retrieves the full change history (activity log) for a specific issue.

issue.description: Select the issue to work with.

categories.description: Select which types of activities to include.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve the change history (activity log) for an issue, given its ID, filtered to the selected activity types (custom field changes and/or comments). Use to audit what changed on an issue and by whom. Read-only and idempotent.

add_comment.name: add_comment
add_comment.description: Adds a comment to an issue. Supports Markdown formatting.

issue.description: Select the issue to work with.

text.description: The comment text. Use Markdown for formatting. Mention users with @username.

visibleToGroup.description: Restrict comment visibility to a group. Leave empty for everyone.

aiMetadata.description: Post a comment on an issue, given the issue ID and Markdown text; optionally restrict visibility to a specific group. Use to add a note or reply on an issue. Not idempotent: each call appends a new comment.

list_comments.name: list_comments
list_comments.description: Lists all comments on an issue with author details and timestamps.

issue.description: Select the issue to work with.

aiMetadata.description: List the comments on an issue, given its ID, with author and timestamp details (capped by an optional limit). Use to read the discussion on a known issue. Read-only and idempotent.

add_user_to_team.name: add_user_to_team
add_user_to_team.description: Adds a user as a direct member of a project team, giving them access to the project.

project.description: Select the YouTrack project to work with.

aiMetadata.description: Add a user as a direct member of a project team, granting them access to the project; requires the project ID and the user ID. Idempotent: adding a user who is already a team member leaves membership unchanged.

link_issues.name: link_issues
link_issues.description: Creates a relationship between two issues (e.g. "relates to", "depends on", "is duplicated by").

sourceIssue.description: Select the issue to work with.

targetIssueId.description: The readable ID of the issue to link to (e.g. "NP-92"). You can find this in the issue URL or header.

linkType.description: The type of relationship between the issues.

aiMetadata.description: Create a directional relationship between two issues, given the source issue ID, the readable target issue ID (e.g. "NP-92"), and a link type (relates to, depends on, duplicates, parent for, subtask of, etc.). Idempotent: re-creating an existing link of the same type leaves the relationship unchanged.

list_attachments.name: list_attachments
list_attachments.description: Lists all attachments on a specific issue with metadata (name, size, type).

issue.description: Select the issue to work with.

aiMetadata.description: List the attachments on an issue, given its ID, with metadata (name, size, content type, author) capped by an optional limit. Use to discover attachment IDs before downloading or deleting them. Read-only and idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

new_issue.name: new_issue
new_issue.description: Triggers when a new issue is created in any project you can access.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new issue is created in any YouTrack project the connected account can access. Each event represents one newly created issue with its summary, project, reporter, and field values.

updated_issue.name: updated_issue
updated_issue.description: Triggers when an existing issue is modified (summary, description, custom fields, etc.).

aiMetadata.description: Fires when an existing issue is modified — its summary, description, custom fields, or other attributes change. Each event represents one updated issue (issues created within the same polling window are excluded). Use to react to changes on already-existing issues rather than brand-new ones.

nl.Connect your YouTrack instance.\n\n**How:
Verbind je YouTrack instantie.

**Hoe krijg je permanente token:**
1. Log in op je YouTrack instantie
2. Klik op je avatar -> **Profiel** -> **Authenticatie** tabblad
3. Klik **Nieuw permanent token**
4. Noem het (bijv. "Activepieces") en klik op **Aanmaken**
5. **Kopieer de token onmiddellijk** - het wordt slechts eenmaal
6. Plak het hieronder met uw Instantie URL

Uw **Instantie URL** is uw browser adres, bijvoorbeeld https://example.youtrack.cloud

de.JetBrains project management and issue t: JetBrains Projektmanagement und Issue-Tracking für agile Teams.
de.From Profile -> Authentication -> Perman: Unter Profil -> Authentifizierung -> Permanente Token. Beginnt mit "perm:".
de.Connect your YouTrack instance.\n\n**How:
Verbinden Sie Ihre YouTrack Instanz.

**Wie Sie Ihren permanenten Token bekommen:**
1. Melden Sie sich bei Ihrer YouTrack Instanz
2. Klicke auf deinen Avatar -> **Profil** -> **Authentifizierung** Tab
3. Klicke auf **neuen permanenten Token**
4. Benennen Sie es (z.B. "Activepieces") und klicken Sie auf **Erstellen**
5. **Kopieren Sie das Token sofort** - es wird nur einmal
angezeigt. Fügen Sie es unten mit Ihrer Instanz-URL

Ihre **Instanz-URL** ist Ihre Browseradresse, z.B. https://example.youtrack.cloud
de.Creates a new issue in a YouTrack projec: Erstellt ein neues Problem in einem YouTrack-Projekt.
de.Retrieves full details of an issue inclu: Ruft alle Details eines Problems einschließlich aller benutzerdefinierten Feldwerte ab.
de.Searches for issues using YouTrack query: Sucht nach Problemen, die YouTrack-Abfragesyntax verwenden. Gibt flache Zeilen für Tabellenkalkulationen zurück.
de.Updates an existing issue - summary, des: Aktualisiert ein bestehendes Problem - Zusammenfassung, Beschreibung oder benutzerdefinierte Felder.
de.Applies a YouTrack command to an issue (: Fügt einen YouTrack-Befehl auf ein Problem ein (z.B. Status ändern, zuweisen, Sprint setzen).
Fügt ein existierendes Tag einem Problem hinzu.
Entfernt ein Schlagwort von einem Problem.
Erstellt einen neuen Tag in YouTrack.
de.Lists all tags visible to the current us: Listet alle für den aktuellen Benutzer sichtbaren Tags auf.
de.Uploads one or more files as attachments: Lädt eine oder mehrere Dateien als Anhänge zu einem existierenden Problem.
Löscht einen Anhang von einem Issue.
de.Downloads an attachment from an issue an: Lädt einen Anhang von einem Problem herunter und gibt ihn als Base64-kodierten String zurück. Verwenden Sie dies mit den Aktionen "Hochladen zum Laufwerk" oder "E-Mail senden" in Ihrem Fluss.
de.Retrieves the full change history (activ: Ruft den vollständigen Änderungsverlauf (Aktivitätsprotokoll) für ein spezielles Problem ab.
de.Adds a comment to an issue. Supports Mar: Fügt einen Kommentar zu einem Problem hinzu. Unterstützt Markdown Formatierung.
de.Lists all comments on an issue with auth: Listet alle Kommentare zu einem Problem mit Autorendetails und Zeitstempeln auf.
de.Adds a user as a direct member of a proj: Fügt einen Benutzer als direktes Mitglied eines Projektteams hinzu und gibt ihm Zugang zum Projekt.
de.Creates a relationship between two issue: Erzeugt eine Beziehung zwischen zwei Themen (z.B. "bezieht sich auf", "hängt auf", "wird dupliziert von").
de.Lists all attachments on a specific issu: Listet alle Anhänge eines bestimmten Problems mit Metadaten (Name, Größe, Typ) auf.
de.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Einen benutzerdefinierten API-Aufruf an einen bestimmten Endpunkt machen
de.Select the YouTrack project to work with: Wählen Sie das YouTrack-Projekt, mit dem gearbeitet werden soll.
Ein kurzer, einzeiliger Titel für das Thema.
Wählen Sie das Problem, mit dem gearbeitet werden soll.
de.Optional: filter by project. Leave empty: Optional: Filter nach Projekt. Leer lassen, um durch alle Projekte zu suchen.
de.YouTrack search query. Examples:\n- #unr:
YouTrack Suchanfrage. Beispiele:
- #ungelöste Probleme - alle ungelösten Probleme
- zugewiesen: mir - zugewiesen
- Priorität: Kritisch - kritische Priorität
- Erstellt: diese Woche - Erstellt in dieser Woche
- Zusammenfassung: Login - Probleme mit der Erwähnung von "Login"
de.Maximum issues to return. Default is 100: Maximale Anzahl zurückzugebender Tickets. Standard ist 100.
Neue Zusammenfassung. Leer lassen um zu behalten.
Neue Beschreibung. Leer lassen um zu behalten.
de.YouTrack command. Examples: State Fixed: YouTrack Befehl. Beispiele: Staat repariert | Zuweiser jane.doe | Priorität kritisch | für mich kritisch
Wählen Sie ein Schlagwort, das auf das Problem angewendet werden soll.
de.Filter tags by name. Leave empty for all: Tags nach Namen filtern. Leer lassen für alle.
de.Add files to attach. Each needs a file n: Fügen Sie Dateien zum Anhang hinzu. Jede Datei benötigt einen Dateinamen und base64-verschlüsselten Inhalt.
Die Datenbank-ID des Anhangs (z.B. "134-31"). Sie können die IDs der Anhänge über die Aktion "Problem herunterladen" finden — suchen Sie nach den IDs in der Ausgabe.
de.The attachment database ID (e.g. \"134-3: Die Anhangdatenbank-ID (z.B. "134-31"). Verwenden Sie "Anhänge auflisten", um sie zu finden.
de.Select which types of activities to incl: Wählen Sie aus, welche Arten von Aktivitäten enthalten sollen.
de.The comment text. Use Markdown for forma: Der Kommentartext. Verwenden Sie Markdown für die Formatierung. Erwähnen Sie Benutzer mit @username.
Die Sichtbarkeit von Kommentaren auf eine Gruppe beschränken. Leer lassen für alle.
de.The readable ID of the issue to link to: Die lesbare ID des zu verlinkenden Issues (z.B. "NP-92"). Diese finden Sie in der Issue-URL oder im Header.
de.The type of relationship between the iss: Die Art der Beziehung zwischen den Problemen.
de.Authorization headers are injected autom: Autorisierungs-Header werden automatisch von Ihrer Verbindung injiziert.
Aktivieren für Dateien wie PDFs, Bilder usw.

de.Triggers when an existing issue is modif: Wird ausgelöst, wenn ein vorhandenes Problem geändert wird (Zusammenfassung, Beschreibung, benutzerdefinierte Felder, etc.).

fr.JetBrains project management and issue t: La gestion de projet JetBrains et le suivi des problèmes pour les équipes agiles.
Votre URL YouTrack (par exemple https://example.youtrack.cloud). N'incluez PAS /api.
fr.From Profile -> Authentication -> Perman: Depuis Profil -> Authentification -> Jetons permanents. Commence par "perm:".
fr.Connect your YouTrack instance.\n\n**How:
Connectez votre instance YouTrack.

**Comment obtenir votre jeton permanent :**
1. Connectez-vous à votre instance YouTrack
2. Cliquez sur votre avatar -> **Profil** -> **Authentification** onglet
3. Cliquez sur **Nouveau jeton permanent**
4. Nommez-le (par exemple "Activepieces") et cliquez sur **Créer**
5. **Copiez le jeton immédiatement** - il n'est affiché qu'une fois
6. Collez-le ci-dessous avec votre URL Instance

Votre **URL Instance** est votre adresse de navigateur, par exemple https://example.youtrack.cloud
fr.Add User to Project Team: Ajouter un utilisateur à l'équipe du projet
fr.Creates a new issue in a YouTrack projec: Crée un nouveau ticket dans un projet YouTrack.
fr.Retrieves full details of an issue inclu: Récupère tous les détails d'un problème incluant toutes les valeurs de champs personnalisés.
fr.Searches for issues using YouTrack query: Recherche les problèmes en utilisant la syntaxe de requête YouTrack. Renvoie des lignes plates pour les feuilles de calcul.
fr.Updates an existing issue - summary, des: Met à jour un problème existant - résumé, description ou champs personnalisés.
fr.Applies a YouTrack command to an issue (: Applique une commande YouTrack à un problème (par exemple changer d'état, d'assignation, de set sprint).
Ajoute un tag existant à un ticket.
Crée un nouveau tag dans YouTrack.
fr.Lists all tags visible to the current us: Liste tous les tags visibles par l'utilisateur actuel.
fr.Uploads one or more files as attachments: Télécharge un ou plusieurs fichiers en tant que pièces jointes à un problème existant.
Supprime une pièce jointe d'un ticket.
fr.Downloads an attachment from an issue an: Télécharge une pièce jointe à partir d'une fiche et la retourne sous la forme d'une chaîne encodée en Base64. Utilisez ceci avec les actions "Upload to Drive" ou "Send E-mail" dans votre flux.
fr.Retrieves the full change history (activ: Récupère l'historique complet des changements (journal d'activité) pour un problème spécifique.
fr.Adds a comment to an issue. Supports Mar: Ajoute un commentaire à un problème. Supporte le formatage Markdown.
fr.Lists all comments on an issue with auth: Liste tous les commentaires sur un problème avec les détails de l'auteur et les horodatages.
fr.Adds a user as a direct member of a proj: Ajoute un utilisateur en tant que membre direct d'une équipe de projet, lui donnant accès au projet.
fr.Creates a relationship between two issue: Crée une relation entre deux fiches (par exemple, "se rapporte à", "dépend de", "est dupliqué par").
fr.Lists all attachments on a specific issu: Liste toutes les pièces jointes sur un problème spécifique avec des métadonnées (nom, taille, type).
fr.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Passer un appel API personnalisé à un endpoint spécifique
fr.Select the YouTrack project to work with: Sélectionnez le projet YouTrack avec lequel vous pouvez travailler.
Un titre court d'une seule ligne pour le numéro.
Sélectionnez le problème avec lequel vous souhaitez travailler.
fr.Optional: filter by project. Leave empty: Facultatif : filtrer par projet. Laisser vide pour rechercher dans tous les projets.
fr.YouTrack search query. Examples:\n- #unr:
